# Arblok Digital

> Studio perangkat lunak dari Tasikmalaya yang membantu usaha, sekolah, dan instansi merapikan pencatatan, pelayanan, serta alur persetujuan.

Optional interface language: English (client-side toggle on the same URLs)
Service area: Indonesia
Contact: https://wa.me/6289508053795

## What Arblok Digital does

Arblok Digital studies an existing workflow, selects one priority problem, builds a first version for users to test, and adjusts the system around operational needs.

Examples of needs:
- Sales, transaction, and inventory records (kasir / point of sale)
- School payment and administration records
- Document requests, reviews, and approvals
- Websites and information portals
- Repeated tasks that may use automatic rules or intelligent technology

## Pricing and timeline

Pricing is flexible; no budget is considered too small. A Starter/MVP package is always available. Landing pages or simple company profiles typically take 1-3 weeks; custom systems (POS, school, village administration) take 1-3 months. Thanks to a direct-to-database architecture (Row Level Security), monthly hosting can be Rp 0 for typical small-business workloads. Consult specific figures via WhatsApp; final pricing is confirmed during the initial discussion.

## Who it serves

- Small and medium businesses
- Schools and education administrators
- Public or community organizations
